name: task_tail_and_provenance
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd();print(Path('TASK.txt').read_text()[59000:]);print('VERIFY IMPLEMENTATION');print(Path('verify_frozen.py').read_text())
f=json.loads(Path('provenance-initial.json').read_text())
for x in f:
 b=Path(f"originals/{x['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes();m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',b);assert m
 token=m.group(1);statement=json.loads(token).encode('utf8');x.update(raw_line_path=f"originals/{x['id']}.jsonl",raw_line_utf8=b.decode(),raw_statement_token_utf8=token.decode(),raw_statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),decoded_statement_utf8=statement.decode(),decoded_statement_sha256=hashlib.sha256(statement).hexdigest(),newline_hex='0a' if b.endswith(b'\n') else '')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'original-provenance.json'],input=json.dumps(f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('Twenty raw line/token/decoded bindings saved')
